nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 of token balances, private state variable in OCTOPUS.
Mapping address => mapping(address => uint256) allowance storage, private state variable in OCTOPUS.
Total supply of SMOOT tokens, 1500000000000000000000 at deploy; mutated by burn logic.
Public uint256 basePercent = 100 used by findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.
Private token name string stored in ERC20Detailed.
Private token symbol string stored in ERC20Detailed.
Private uint8 decimals stored in ERC20Detailed.
Constant string "OCTOPUS FINANCE".
Constant string "SMOOT".
Constant uint8 18 token decimals.
Public transfer(address to,uint256 value): burns 1% of value, moves remainder, updates _balances and _totalSupply.
Public transferFrom(address from,address to,uint256 value): allowance-based transfer with 1% burn, mutates _balances, _allowed, _totalSupply.
Public multiTransfer(address[] receivers,uint256[] amounts): loops and calls transfer for each pair.
Public approve(address spender,uint256 value): sets _allowed[msg.sender][spender] without safe-increase check.
Public increaseAllowance(address spender,uint256 addedValue): adds to allowance using SafeMath.add.
Public decreaseAllowance(address spender,uint256 subtractedValue): subtracts from allowance using SafeMath.sub.
Public view findOnePercent(uint256 value): rounds value up to basePercent and divides to compute fee amount.
External burn(uint256 amount): burns caller's own tokens via _burn(msg.sender, amount).
Internal _burn(address account,uint256 amount): reduces _totalSupply and _balances[account], emits Transfer to address(0).
External burnFrom(address account,uint256 amount): spends allowance then calls _burn.
Internal _totsupply(address account,uint256 amount): mints initial supply to account during construction.
Public view balanceOf(address owner): returns _balances[owner].
Public view allowance(address owner,address spender): returns _allowed[owner][spender].
Public view totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply.
Payable constructor of OCTOPUS that mints _totalSupply to msg.sender via _totsupply.
Internal SafeMath.mul(uint256 a,uint256 b): multiplication with overflow assertion.
Internal SafeMath.sub(uint256 a,uint256 b): subtraction with underflow assertion.
Internal SafeMath.add(uint256 a,uint256 b): addition with overflow assertion.
Internal SafeMath.div(uint256 a,uint256 b): integer division without zero-check.
Internal SafeMath.ceil(uint256 a,uint256 m): rounds a up to nearest multiple of m.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balance, allowance and burn authorization.
Arithmetic in transfer: value.sub(tokensToBurn), _balances[msg.sender].sub(value), _totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn).
Arithmetic in transferFrom: subtraction of value, tokensToBurn and allowance from storage balances.
Arithmetic in findOnePercent: mul(basePercent).div(10000) fee computation used for burn amounts.
Arithmetic in _burn: _totalSupply.sub(amount) and _balances[account].sub(amount).
Loop-driven state-mutating call transfer(receivers[i], amounts[i]) invoked from multiTransfer.
Arithmetic in increaseAllowance: _allowed[msg.sender][spender].add(addedValue).
Arithmetic in decreaseAllowance: _allowed[msg.sender][spender].sub(subtractedValue).
